# HireSquire API - Comprehensive AI Agent Documentation

Primary keywords: autonomous recruiting, AI headhunter toolkit, programmatic candidate sourcing, agentic workflows, resume screening API, candidate scoring model, HireSquire Python SDK, HireSquire CLI, MCP recruiting server.

## Discovery & distribution

- SDK (PyPI): https://pypi.org/project/hiresquire/
- Repo: https://github.com/bp46/hiresquire
- OpenAPI spec: https://hiresquireai.com/openapi.json
- MCP (server-side JSON-RPC): https://hiresquireai.com/api/v1/mcp
- MCP (stdio client): `hiresquire mcp` / `hiresquire-mcp`

## Authentication

`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens from the dashboard (`/profile` → API Tokens).
Agent keys (`hs_...`) support spend limits and scoped permissions
(`read`, `write`, `screen`, `email`, `bulk`).

## Basic workflow

1. `GET /api/v1/schema/validate` — verify token + balance (free).
2. `POST /api/v1/jobs` — submit screening job. Returns `job_id`.
3. `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}` — poll until `completed`.
4. `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}/results` — candidate scores/summaries.
5. `POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/generate-email` — outreach.
6. `POST /api/v1/interviews` — schedule.

## Response codes

- 202 Accepted: job created, poll required
- 200 OK: success
- 401 Unauthorized: invalid token
- 402 Payment Required: agent spend limit reached
- 403 Forbidden: insufficient permissions
- 422 Unprocessable Entity: validation error
- 425 Too Early: job still processing
- 429 Too Many Requests: rate limited

## Endpoints (selected)

### POST /api/v1/jobs

Body: `title` (max 255), `description` (min 50), `resumes` (array of
`{filename, content}`), optional `leniency_level` (1-10), `custom_instructions`,
`webhook_url`, `webhook_conditions`, `idempotency_key`.

Response: `{job_id, status, status_url, results_url}`.

### GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}/results

Candidates sorted by score. Query params: `min_score`, `only_top_n` (max 100).

### Credits

`GET /api/v1/credits/balance`, `POST /api/v1/credits/purchase`,
`GET /api/v1/credits/packs`, `POST /api/v1/credits/auto-reload/enable|disable`.

### Agent keys

`GET/POST /api/v1/agent-keys`, `GET/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/agent-keys/{id}`,
`POST /api/v1/agent-keys/{id}/regenerate`, `GET /api/v1/agent-keys/{id}/usage`.

### Calendar

`GET/POST /api/v1/calendar/connections`, `GET /api/v1/calendar/slots`,
`POST /api/v1/interviews`, `POST /api/v1/meetings/links`.

### MCP (stdio)

`hiresquire mcp` exposes 26 tools mapping 1:1 to the REST endpoints above.
`create_screening` accepts `resume_paths` (local files parsed client-side) or
`resumes` (pre-parsed content).

## Webhooks

Set `webhook_url` on job creation. Verify `X-Webhook-Signature` via HMAC-SHA256.

## Best practices

- Health check (`whoami`) before starting work.
- Handle 429 with exponential backoff; respect `retry-after`.
- Use webhooks for batches > 10 resumes.
- Use agent keys with spend limits for autonomous agents.
- Idempotency keys prevent double-charges on retry.

## Compliance

Automated bias/disparate-impact audit (NYC LL144 / EEOC 4/5ths) with public
certificate. Human-in-the-loop; no unilateral employment decisions.
